meaning: Exact expected outcomes for each assessment row and verification profile using frozen PCC v0.8.1 inputs. Includes dimension states, hard findings encoded as dimension|code|rawReason|subjectRefs|missingRefs, and advisories encoded as code|subjectRefs. These reproduction targets were cross-checked against requirements.json, legacy ladder results, and the frozen 24-pair HashCoC comparison. They are not an independent oracle.

classCounts.source: Panduan Perbaikan §2.2 (definisi: jumlah baris dengan >=1 hard finding; T3 any = hard OR advisory)

identityScope.source: Audit cakupan identitas 5 Okt (paket ladder) dan identity_scope.csv lama; dihitung ulang tiap run oleh diagnostics.js
